title: Relicta MCP Apps
description:
Add MCP app resources to Relicta so that interactive, rich UI views render
directly inside Claude Desktop (or any MCP client). This turns Relicta from
a tool-call interface into an embedded governance workspace where users
visually inspect risk, approve releases, review commit classifications,
and track the release pipeline — all inline.

features.title: MCP App Resource Infrastructure
features.description:
Register MCP app resources in the existing MCP server so clients can
discover and render HTML/JS apps. Reuse Vue components from web/src/
where possible. Support embedding built assets as Go embed.FS.

requirements.description: Register MCP resource templates that serve HTML app bundles
Embed compiled Vue app bundles into the Go binary via embed.FS
Apps receive context data (release state, config) via resource URI params or injected JSON

features.title: Release Pipeline Visualizer App
features.description:
Render the full release state machine (plan → bump → notes → evaluate →
approve → publish) as a visual pipeline. Show current step, completed
steps, and available next actions.

requirements.description: Visual pipeline showing all release stages and current position
Buttons/links to trigger next steps via MCP tool calls

features.title: CGP Risk Dashboard App
features.description:
Render CGP risk evaluation as a visual dashboard with severity gauges,
per-factor breakdowns, and clear pass/fail indicators.

requirements.description: Visual risk level gauge with color-coded severity
Per-factor risk breakdown (file churn, breaking changes, dependencies)

features.title: Commit Classification Review App
features.description:
Render commit analysis results as an interactive table showing each
commit's classification, confidence, and type. Allow override review.

requirements.description: Table of commits with hash, message, classification type, and confidence
Summary counts by type (feat, fix, breaking, chore) with version bump recommendation

features.title: Approval Workflow App
features.description:
Present a consolidated approval view with risk summary, release notes
preview, diff stats, and policy compliance — all in one place.

requirements.description: Consolidated checklist of release readiness criteria
Inline release notes preview within the approval view

features.title: Blast Radius Visualization App
features.description:
Render monorepo blast radius analysis as a dependency graph showing
impacted packages, transitive effects, and deployment risk.

requirements.description: Visual dependency graph highlighting affected packages

constraints.description: Apps must be lightweight HTML/CSS/JS bundles (no heavy framework runtime in MCP apps)
Reuse existing Vue component logic from web/src/ where applicable
Apps render read-only data; actions delegate back to MCP tool calls
All apps must work with the existing stdio MCP transport
